description: Edits a draft in a conversation's draft box, as a person typing in it does: body, subject (email), whyNote, isReady, or status 'discarded' to throw it away. Nothing is sent; a person still presses Send. draft_id comes from create_draft or read. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_draft
title: Edit or discard a draft
